about_the_game:
Note: The combat mission will be available from 14 November.

8th anniversary of World of Warships on Steam! Unlock this celebratory goodie pack to get all things Steam: a Steam permanent camouflage, container, patch, and flag, plus 3 days of Warships Premium Account and a mission granting the Steam Cat permanent camouflage.

This package includes:

  • 1x Steam container

  • Steam patch symbol and background

  • Steam permanent camouflage

  • Piece of Cake flag

  • 3 days of Warships Premium Account

  • Access to a two-part combat mission chain. Complete to receive: Steam Cat permanent camouflage for German Tier V cruiser Königsberg, Steam container, Steam permanent camouflage.

Key features:

  • Unique Steam-themed items

  • Each Steam container drops three items (percentages indicate drop probability):- 1 day of Warships Premium Account (20%); or 250 Doubloons (20%); or 10,000 Free XP (20%); or 5x Steam expendable camouflages (40%).- 3x "Credits +20%" expendable economic bonuses (25%); or 3x "Ship XP +100%" expendable economic bonuses (25%); or 3x "Commander XP +100%" expendable economic bonuses (25%); or 3x "Free XP +300%" expendable economic bonuses (25%).- 5x November Foxtrot signals (40%) or 5x Charlie Kilo signals (60%).

The Premium Account will activate and start counting down when you log in to the game after making the purchase.

This DLC can be downloaded only once per account.

You will not receive any compensation if you already own the Steam Cat permanent camouflage.

This time-limited exclusive DLC is available until November 26, 2025.
